title: Verify that the footer renders all sections on every page
description: Confirms the complete footer structure renders when a visitor scrolls to the bottom of any page.

steps.action: Navigate to any page of the Qatar Chamber website
steps.expected: Page loads successfully

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of the page
steps.expected: Footer renders with Qatar Chamber logo + description, Social Media Label + icons, navigation columns, Quick Links column, newsletter section, and copyright bar

title: Verify that clicking the footer logo redirects to the Home Page
description: Confirms the footer logo acts as a link back to the Home Page from any page.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer on any non-home page
steps.expected: Footer logo is visible

steps.action: Click the Qatar Chamber footer logo
steps.expected: Visitor is redirected to the Home Page

title: Verify that an internal footer navigation link opens in the same tab
description: Confirms internal footer navigation links keep the visitor within the same browsing context.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Footer navigation column is visible with active links

steps.action: Click a footer navigation link configured as internal
steps.expected: Link opens in the same browser tab and navigates to the configured target

title: Verify that an external footer navigation link opens in a new tab
description: Confirms external footer navigation links open in a new tab so the visitor doesn't lose their place on the site.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Footer navigation column is visible

steps.action: Click a footer navigation link configured as external
steps.expected: Link opens the configured target URL in a new browser tab

title: Verify that the Quick Links column renders its heading and active quick links
description: Confirms the Quick Links column displays its configured heading and all active quick links beneath it.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer with at least one active quick link configured
steps.expected: Footer renders

steps.action: Observe the Quick Links column
steps.expected: Quick Links column heading (e.g. 'Quick Links') is displayed with all active quick links listed beneath it

title: Verify that the Quick Links column is hidden when no quick links are active
description: Confirms the entire Quick Links column and heading are omitted when there is no active quick link content.

steps.action: Configure the CMS so that no quick links are active
steps.expected: CMS has zero active quick links

steps.action: Load any page and scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Quick Links column and its heading are not rendered in the footer

title: Verify that clicking a quick link redirects to its configured URL
description: Confirms quick links navigate visitors to their configured destination in the configured tab behavior.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer Quick Links column
steps.expected: Quick Links column is visible with active links

steps.action: Click an active quick link
steps.expected: Visitor is redirected to the configured URL in the configured tab (same/new)

title: Verify that clicking a social media icon opens the official channel in a new tab
description: Confirms social media icons in the footer link out to official Qatar Chamber channels in a new tab.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer social icons row
steps.expected: Social icons row is visible below the 'Follow Us on Social Media' label

steps.action: Click an active social media icon
steps.expected: The official Qatar Chamber channel opens in a new browser tab

title: Verify that subscribing with a valid email shows a success confirmation
description: Confirms the footer newsletter subscription flow succeeds and confirms success to the visitor for a valid email.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer newsletter section
steps.expected: Newsletter section is visible with heading, description, email input, and Subscribe button

steps.action: Enter a valid email address in the newsletter field
steps.expected: Email is accepted

steps.action: Click the Subscribe button
steps.expected: Success confirmation message is displayed

title: Verify that submitting an empty or invalid email shows an inline validation error
description: Confirms the newsletter field blocks submission and shows a validation message for empty or malformed emails.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer newsletter section
steps.expected: Newsletter section is visible

steps.action: Leave the email field empty or enter an invalid email format
steps.expected: Subscription is blocked

steps.action: Click the Subscribe button
steps.expected: Inline validation message 'Please enter a valid email address.' is displayed

title: Verify that a newsletter backend error displays the appropriate error message
description: Confirms a subscription-service failure surfaces a clear error message rather than failing silently.

steps.action: Scroll to the footer newsletter section
steps.expected: Newsletter section accepts a valid email

steps.action: Enter a valid email address
steps.expected: Backend subscription call fails

steps.action: Trigger a backend subscription failure (e.g. simulate service outage) and click Subscribe
steps.expected: Error message 'Unable to process your subscription. Please try again later.' is displayed

title: Verify that the copyright bar displays copyright text and bottom bar links correctly
description: Confirms the bottom strip of the footer shows copyright text and the policy links in the correct layout.

steps.action: Scroll to the very bottom of the footer
steps.expected: Copyright bar is visible at the bottom

steps.action: Observe the copyright bar
steps.expected: Copyright text appears on the left; Accessibility, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service links appear on the right

title: Verify that clicking the Back to Top icon scrolls the page to the top
description: Confirms the Back to Top affordance in the footer returns the visitor to the top of the page.

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of any page to reveal the footer
steps.expected: Back to Top icon is visible in the footer

steps.action: Click the Back to Top icon
steps.expected: Page scrolls back to the top

title: Verify that the footer layout mirrors RTL when Arabic language is selected
description: Confirms the footer layout mirrors right-to-left when the visitor switches the site to Arabic.

steps.action: Switch the site language to Arabic
steps.expected: Language switches to Arabic

steps.action: Scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Footer layout mirrors right-to-left (RTL): logo/branding, nav columns, quick links, newsletter, and copyright bar are horizontally mirrored

title: Verify that the footer falls back to the default language when a translation is missing
description: Confirms footer content never renders blank when a bilingual field lacks a translation for the active language.

steps.action: Configure a footer field (e.g. a nav link title) with no Arabic translation while other fields are translated
steps.expected: Field is missing an Arabic translation

steps.action: Switch the site language to Arabic and scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Footer displays the configured default language text for that field instead of a blank or broken value

title: Verify that disabling an individual footer element hides only that element
description: Confirms deactivating a single footer record (nav link, quick link, social icon, copyright, bottom bar link) hides only that item while other active content remains.

steps.action: In the CMS, set one footer nav link, one quick link, one social icon, the copyright text, and one bottom bar link to inactive status
steps.expected: Elements are set to inactive in CMS

steps.action: Publish the change
steps.expected: Publish succeeds

steps.action: Load any page and scroll to the footer
steps.expected: Each disabled element is hidden from the footer while all other active elements remain visible and functional

title: Verify that admin can upload footer logo with alt text and redirect URL
description: Confirms a Site Content Editor can configure the footer logo, its bilingual alt text, and its redirect URL, and that the change publishes correctly.

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as Site Content Editor
steps.expected: Admin is logged in with correct role

steps.action: Navigate to Global Components > Footer Management
steps.expected: Footer Management module is accessible

steps.action: Upload a valid logo image (PNG/SVG, under 2MB), enter bilingual alt text, and enter a redirect URL
steps.expected: Logo, alt text (EN/AR), and redirect URL are saved

steps.action: Save and publish
steps.expected: Liferay success toast is displayed and footer reflects the new logo after cache refresh

title: Verify that saving the footer logo without an image shows a required-field error
description: Confirms the CMS blocks saving Footer Management if the logo image is missing.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management
steps.expected: Footer Management form is open

steps.action: Leave the Footer Logo Image field empty
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Footer Logo Image is required.' / AR 'صورة شعار التذييل مطلوبة.'

title: Verify that admin can create, edit, and reorder footer navigation columns
description: Confirms footer navigation columns can be created, edited, and reordered via Footer Management.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management
steps.expected: Footer Management is accessible

steps.action: Add a new navigation column with heading (EN/AR), column number, display order, and active status
steps.expected: New column is created with all fields saved

steps.action: Edit the column's display order
steps.expected: Display order updates correctly

steps.action: Save and publish
steps.expected: Publish succeeds with success toast

title: Verify that a missing column heading shows a required-field error
description: Confirms the CMS blocks saving a navigation column if the English heading is missing.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management
steps.expected: Form is open

steps.action: Add a new navigation column and leave Column Heading (EN) empty
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Column Heading (EN) is required.'

title: Verify that a missing Quick Link Title (EN) shows a required-field error
description: Confirms the CMS blocks saving a quick link if the English title is missing.

steps.action: Navigate to Useful Links Manager
steps.expected: Form is open

steps.action: Click Add Quick Link and leave Title (EN) empty
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Quick Link Title (EN) is required.'

title: Verify that an invalid Quick Link URL shows a validation error
description: Confirms the CMS validates the Quick Link URL field format before allowing save.

steps.action: Navigate to Useful Links Manager
steps.expected: Form is open

steps.action: Click Add Quick Link and enter an invalid URL format (e.g. 'notaurl')
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Please enter a valid URL.'

title: Verify that admin can add a social media icon entry
description: Confirms a new social media icon can be created with all required fields and appears in the frontend footer after publish.

steps.action: Navigate to Global Components > Social Media Icons Management
steps.expected: Social Media Icons Management is accessible

steps.action: Add a new icon entry with platform name, icon image, bilingual alt text, redirect URL, open-in-new-tab, display order, and active status
steps.expected: New icon entry is saved with all fields

steps.action: Save and publish
steps.expected: Icon appears in the footer social icons row after publish

title: Verify that saving a social icon without an image shows a required-field error
description: Confirms the CMS blocks saving a social media icon entry if the icon image is missing.

steps.action: Navigate to Social Media Icons Management
steps.expected: Form is open

steps.action: Add a new entry and leave Social Icon Image empty
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Social Icon Image is required.'

title: Verify that a missing platform name shows a required-field error
description: Confirms the CMS blocks saving a social media icon entry if the platform name is missing.

steps.action: Navigate to Social Media Icons Management
steps.expected: Form is open

steps.action: Add a new entry and leave Platform Name empty
steps.expected: Save is blocked

steps.action: Attempt to save
steps.expected: Error message displayed: EN 'Platform Name is required.'

title: Verify that admin can configure the newsletter section fields
description: Confirms all newsletter section fields (heading, description, placeholder, button label) can be configured bilingually and reflect on the frontend.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management
steps.expected: Footer Management is accessible

steps.action: Enter Newsletter Heading, Description, Email Placeholder, and Subscribe Button Label (EN/AR)
steps.expected: All newsletter fields are saved

steps.action: Save and publish
steps.expected: Newsletter section reflects the configured content on the frontend after publish

title: Verify that admin can manage copyright text and bottom bar links
description: Confirms copyright text and the bottom bar policy links can be configured and reflect correctly on the frontend.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management
steps.expected: Footer Management is accessible

steps.action: Enter Copyright Text (EN/AR) and set active status
steps.expected: Copyright text and bottom bar links are saved

steps.action: Add or edit bottom bar links (e.g. Accessibility, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service) with title, URL, open-in-new-tab, display order, and active status
steps.expected: Copyright bar reflects configured content and links on the frontend after publish

steps.action: Save and publish
steps.expected: Links are functional and correctly ordered

title: Verify that an admin without permission cannot publish footer configuration
description: Confirms footer publish actions are permission-gated and blocked for users without the appropriate CMS role.

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS with a user role lacking footer publish permission
steps.expected: User is logged in with insufficient permissions

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management and attempt to publish a change
steps.expected: Publish action is blocked and error message displayed: EN 'Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action.'

title: Verify that the draft, preview, and publish lifecycle works for footer records
description: Confirms footer configuration changes can move through draft, preview, and publish states, and reflect on the live frontend after cache refresh.

steps.action: Navigate to Footer Management and make a configuration change
steps.expected: Change is saved as draft without going live

steps.action: Save as draft
steps.expected: Preview shows the change accurately before publish

steps.action: Preview the change
steps.expected: Publish succeeds with success toast

steps.action: Publish the change
steps.expected: Frontend footer reflects the published change

steps.action: Wait for standard cache refresh and load the frontend footer
steps.expected: Change is visible after cache refresh

title: Verify that admin can add a quick link via the Useful Links Manager
description: Confirms a new quick link can be created with all required fields and appears in the frontend Quick Links column after publish.

steps.action: Navigate to Global Components > Useful Links Manager
steps.expected: Useful Links Manager is accessible

steps.action: Set the Quick Links column heading (EN/AR)
steps.expected: New quick link is saved with all fields

steps.action: Click Add Quick Link and enter Title EN, Title AR, URL, Open in New Tab, Display Order, Active Status, then save and publish
steps.expected: Quick link appears in the Quick Links column on the frontend after publish

title: التحقق من أنه يتم عرض تخطيط التذييل من اليمين إلى اليسار عند اختيار اللغة العربية
description: يتحقق من أن تخطيط تذييل الصفحة ينعكس بشكل صحيح من اليمين إلى اليسار عند تبديل لغة الموقع إلى العربية.

steps.action: تبديل لغة الموقع إلى العربية
steps.expected: يتم تبديل اللغة إلى العربية بنجاح

steps.action: التمرير إلى تذييل الصفحة
steps.expected: يظهر تخطيط التذييل معكوسًا من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL): الشعار، أعمدة التنقل، الروابط السريعة، النشرة الإخبارية، وشريط حقوق النشر

title: التحقق من أنه يتم عرض اللغة الافتراضية في التذييل عند عدم توفر ترجمة عربية
description: يتحقق من أن محتوى التذييل لا يظهر فارغًا عند عدم توفر ترجمة عربية لأحد الحقول ثنائية اللغة.

steps.action: إعداد أحد حقول التذييل (مثل عنوان رابط تنقل) بدون ترجمة عربية بينما باقي الحقول مترجمة
steps.expected: الحقل يفتقر إلى الترجمة العربية

steps.action: تبديل لغة الموقع إلى العربية والتمرير إلى التذييل
steps.expected: يعرض التذييل نص اللغة الافتراضية المُعدّة لهذا الحقل بدلاً من قيمة فارغة أو معطوبة

title: التحقق من أنه تظهر رسالة التحقق عند إدخال بريد إلكتروني فارغ أو غير صالح في قسم النشرة الإخبارية
description: يتحقق من أن حقل النشرة الإخبارية يمنع الإرسال ويعرض رسالة تحقق عند إدخال بريد إلكتروني فارغ أو بصيغة غير صحيحة، باللغة العربية.

steps.action: التمرير إلى قسم النشرة الإخبارية في التذييل مع تفعيل اللغة العربية
steps.expected: يظهر قسم النشرة الإخبارية باللغة العربية

steps.action: ترك حقل البريد الإلكتروني فارغًا أو إدخال بريد إلكتروني بصيغة غير صحيحة
steps.expected: يتم منع الاشتراك

steps.action: النقر على زر الاشتراك
steps.expected: تظهر رسالة التحقق: 'يرجى إدخال عنوان بريد إلكتروني صالح.'

title: التحقق من أنه تظهر رسالة الخطأ عند فشل خادم الاشتراك في النشرة الإخبارية
description: يتحقق من ظهور رسالة خطأ واضحة باللغة العربية عند فشل خدمة الاشتراك في الخادم.

steps.action: التمرير إلى قسم النشرة الإخبارية مع تفعيل اللغة العربية
steps.expected: يتم قبول البريد الإلكتروني الصالح

steps.action: إدخال بريد إلكتروني صالح
steps.expected: يفشل طلب الاشتراك في الخادم

steps.action: محاكاة فشل الخادم عند النقر على زر الاشتراك
steps.expected: تظهر رسالة الخطأ: 'لا يمكن معالجة اشتراكك. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى لاحقاً.'

title: التحقق من أنه تظهر رسالة الحقل المطلوب عند إغفال عنوان العمود باللغة العربية
description: يتحقق من أن نظام إدارة المحتوى يمنع الحفظ عند إغفال عنوان عمود التنقل باللغة العربية، مع عرض رسالة الخطأ المناسبة.

steps.action: الدخول إلى نظام إدارة المحتوى Liferay CMS بصلاحية محرر المحتوى
steps.expected: نموذج إدارة التذييل مفتوح

steps.action: الانتقال إلى إدارة التذييل وإضافة عمود تنقل جديد
steps.expected: يتم منع الحفظ

steps.action: ترك حقل عنوان العمود (عربي) فارغًا ومحاولة الحفظ
steps.expected: تظهر رسالة الخطأ: 'عنوان العمود (عربي) مطلوب.'

title: التحقق من أنه تظهر رسالة رفض الوصول باللغة العربية عند محاولة مستخدم غير مصرح له نشر إعدادات التذييل
description: يتحقق من أن إجراء نشر إعدادات التذييل مقيّد بالصلاحيات، ويتم حظره مع عرض رسالة رفض الوصول باللغة العربية للمستخدمين غير المصرح لهم.

steps.action: تسجيل الدخول إلى Liferay CMS بحساب لا يملك صلاحية نشر إعدادات التذييل
steps.expected: المستخدم مسجل الدخول بدون الصلاحيات الكافية

steps.action: الانتقال إلى إدارة التذييل ومحاولة نشر تغيير
steps.expected: يتم منع إجراء النشر وتظهر رسالة الخطأ: 'تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.'
